recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white portrait framed within a thick black border, featuring a central figure with heavy shadows and a vibrant red, dripping script title overlaid on the forehead. The layout mimics a vintage magazine or fanzine cover with technical metadata at the margins.
coreVisualRelationships: Red script as the singular color focal point against a monochrome base
High-threshold portraiture creating a graphic, ink-like texture
Strict rectangular framing with wide white margins for secondary text
Vertical orientation of side text contrasting with horizontal bottom metadata
coreInvariants: Pure black and white threshold for the image
Blood-red accent color for the primary title
Dripping liquid effect on the main lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait occupying 70% of the black frame, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red dripping text positioned at the top-center of the portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title, moves down the high-contrast facial features to the necklace, then outward to the marginal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black within the frame and stark white in the outer margins.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tones; high saturation for the red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, gestural strokes with varying thickness
Vertical 'drips' extending from the bottom of every letter
Aggressive, sharp terminals on the top strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated to facilitate the dripping effect
Horizontal crossbars are thin and sharp

composition.position: bottom margin and right vertical edge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script paired with rigid, geometric sans-serif for a 'technical document' feel.
graphicDevices: Vertical text alignment on the right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, liquid energy of the main title.
Provides the necessary utilitarian look for the marginal text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, black and white threshold portrait of a person with a cross necklace, framed by a thick black rectangular border on a white canvas. Ensure no grey tones exist.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, blood-red title in a dripping, aggressive script across the top of the portrait. Place small, spaced-out sans-serif metadata in the bottom white margin and vertically along the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the red text the only color in the image?
Is the portrait strictly black and white with no grey?
Are the margins wide and white?
Does the red text have visible vertical drips?

adjustableVariables: Drip length of the red text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
postGenerationChecks: Ensure red text is legible despite drips
Verify metadata is aligned to the outer white space
Confirm the portrait feels like a screen print
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + thick black frame + dripping red script overlay + marginal sans-serif metadata.
